suiteOverview.name: Amazon Seller Trend & Opportunity Suite
suiteOverview.purpose: An interactive intelligence toolkit for Amazon private label brand builders and sellers to discover high-velocity product niches, model accurate 2026 FBA unit economics, and exploit competitor review weaknesses.

opportunityScore.definition: A composite 0–100 score rating product niche viability based on 4 pillars: Demand Velocity (up to 30 pts), Competition Review Barrier (up to 30 pts), Margin Potential (up to 25 pts), and Price Sweet Spot (up to 15 pts).

ratings.exceptional: 85–99 pts: High search growth, low review barrier (<300 reviews), net margin >35%, sweet spot pricing.
ratings.strong: 70–84 pts: Healthy growth and viable competition, net margin >25%.
ratings.moderate: 55–69 pts: Moderate competition or lower margin requiring distinct product differentiation.
ratings.challenging: 10–54 pts: Heavy incumbent review barriers (>1,000 top reviews) or thin margins.

opportunityScore.searchGrowthVelocity: 90-day search growth percentage indicating accelerating consumer demand momentum before seasonal spikes or broader market awareness.

tacos.term: Target / Total Advertising Cost of Sales (TACoS)
tacos.formula: Total Ad Spend / Total Gross Revenue * 100
tacos.benchmark: Healthy target is 8%–15% for mature private label products, and 15%–25% during initial product launch.
tacos.significance: TACoS measures overall business health and organic momentum by comparing ad spend against total sales.

acos.significance: ACoS measures direct PPC campaign efficiency on ad clicks.

unitEconomics.landedCost: Total cost per unit delivered to Amazon warehouse = Manufacturing COGS + Inbound Freight / Shipping per unit.
unitEconomics.referralFee: Amazon marketplace commission per sale, typically 15% across most categories with a $0.30 minimum fee.

fbaFulfillmentFee2026.smallStandard: < 16 oz, max 15x12x0.75 in: $3.22 standard / $2.45 low-price rate.
fbaFulfillmentFee2026.largeStandard: 16 oz to 20 lbs, max 18x14x8 in: $4.75 standard / $3.15 low-price rate.
fbaFulfillmentFee2026.largeBulky: Up to 50 lbs: $9.73 standard / $7.50 low-price rate.
fbaFulfillmentFee2026.lowPriceFbaDiscount: Automatic discounted FBA fulfillment rates for any product priced under $10.00.

unitEconomics.breakevenLandedCost: Maximum allowable manufacturing + inbound freight cost per unit before net profit drops to $0.00. Formula = Sale Price - Amazon Referral Fee - FBA Fee - PPC Ad Spend - Return Costs.
unitEconomics.breakevenSalePrice: Minimum retail price required to cover all fixed unit costs and variable percentage fees.
unitEconomics.returnRateImpact: Customer returns reduce margin through reverse logistics, unsellable inventory scrap, and repackaging fees, modeled at an average 40% loss on returned units.

privateLabelStrategy.competitorReviewGapAnalysis: Systematic evaluation of recurring 1-star and 2-star complaints on incumbent competitor listings (e.g. weak hinges, fraying edges, plastic odors) to engineer superior product fixes into your private label manufacturer specifications.
privateLabelStrategy.aPlusContentBrandModules: Enhanced Brand Content on Amazon product detail pages (brand story carousels, technical comparison charts, rich lifestyle feature cards) that boost conversion rate and answer customer objections.
